Package com.smartlostfound.storage

Class MongoItemStorageService

java.lang.Object
com.smartlostfound.storage.MongoItemStorageService
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItemStorageService
public class MongoItemStorageService extends Object implements ItemStorageService
MongoDB-backed item storage service with resilient local CSV fallback. Automatically switches between live MongoDB Atlas/local instances and offline cached storage with zero data loss.
